transcript.text: Before we go any further on the disclosure timeline, I need to flag something important. I've confirmed with our D&O carrier's claims representative that our policy requires written notice to the D&O carrier before the company makes any public release. This confirmation came through in an insurance email that hasn't yet been added to the filing checklist. Given that the audit committee meets tomorrow and the General Counsel will be finalizing the disclosure decision after our findings are reported, we need to make sure this carrier notice requirement is built into our process now.

transcript.text: Thomas, that's a critical flag on the D&O carrier notice, and it reinforces why I need to share what I received this morning. The outside auditor's written conclusion came in, and it expressly states that the revenue-recognition error requires our previously issued quarterly financial statements to be treated as no longer reliable and corrected through a restatement. Critically, the auditor's conclusion specifically requires us to make disclosure under Form 8-K Item 4.02 — 'Non-Reliance on Previously Issued Financial Statements' — rather than filing only a Form 10-Q/A or Form 10-K/A amendment. I held off circulating it because the consolidated disclosure draft was still being assembled, but given the audit committee meets tomorrow and the General Counsel will be finalizing the disclosure decision after our findings are reported, everyone needs to know that the filing classification question has effectively been answered by the auditor. We are looking at an Item 4.02 8-K, not just an amendment.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you both. This is exactly the kind of reporting our quarterly-close protocol is designed to capture before I finalize the disclosure decision. Thomas, the D&O carrier notice requirement is noted — we'll build that into the pre-filing checklist so written notice goes to the carrier before any public release. Daniel, the auditor's written conclusion that we need an Item 4.02 8-K is significant. Under our protocol, once findings from legal, finance, and insurance counsel have been reported to me, I finalize the disclosure decision — including the filing classification — without waiting for a separate later classification confirmation. I'm now in a position to finalize that decision based on what's been reported today. We need to make sure the audit committee is briefed on both the auditor's Item 4.02 conclusion and the D&O carrier notice requirement at tomorrow's meeting, before any filing is made. Let's get the consolidated disclosure draft updated to reflect the 8-K Item 4.02 framework and circulate the carrier notice requirement to the filing team immediately.
